info.title: PackageMedic
info.description: A read-only dependency doctor and restore-validated package simulator for SDK-style .NET projects.

options.name: --config
options.description: Use this configuration file

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Do not auto-load .packagemedic.json

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Compare against this baseline

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Use existing project.assets.json files

options.name: --restore-timeout
options.description: Restore timeout, 1-3600

options.name: --evaluation-timeout
options.description: Per-MSBuild evaluation timeout, 1-3600

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description: Maximum concurrent restore, audit, and MSBuild processes

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format (default: text)
Human or schema-versioned simulation report

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write the selected report
Write the simulation report atomically
--audit / --deprecated       Include matching risk deltas when both analyses complete

options.name: --sarif-output
options.description:
Also write SARIF from the same analysis
--fail-on none|warning|error Fail on any effective diagnostic

options.name: --fail-on-new
options.description: Fail only on diagnostics absent from baseline

options.name: --audit
options.description: Include official NuGet vulnerability audit data

options.name: --deprecated
options.description: Include official NuGet package deprecation data

options.name: --include-transitive
options.description: Include transitive packages in every enabled audit

options.name: --include-transitive-audit
options.description: Include transitive vulnerability evidence only

options.name: --include-transitive-deprecated
options.description:
Include transitive deprecation evidence only
Diff behavior:
Compares the working tree with a safely materialized Git reference.
Reports findings, upgrades/downgrades, dependency-risk deltas, and CPM changes.
--baseline and --fail-on-new are intentionally not accepted by diff.
--no-restore requires usable assets files tracked in both compared trees.
Dependency Time Machine:
Restore-validates one exact package version in two independent snapshots of HEAD.
Requires a clean Git worktree and one unambiguous direct/central declaration.

options.name: --credential-env
options.description:
Explicitly inherit and redact one private-feed variable;
repeat for additional variables
Build, tests, and runtime compatibility are not evaluated. Restore still evaluates
repository-controlled MSBuild content and may contact configured package sources.
--no-restore, baselines, --fail-on-new, and SARIF are intentionally unavailable.
Exit codes:
0  Analysis completed below the configured thresholds
1  A configured gate was reached or a simulated candidate was rejected
2  Usage, restore, configuration, or analysis error
PackageMedic 0.5 remains read-only. clean only supports --dry-run.
